Episode 258. The Predator of All Dimensions (6)
"Hoo, hoo..."
Luna let out a ragged breath and shrouded Krantel in a new layer of crimson energy. Despite her exhaustion, the crimson energy glowed with the same deep light as it had at the beginning.
With Jin's aging no longer a factor, the Genesis Knights could breathe a little easier.
Of course, the fundamental situation had not improved. They had only momentarily pushed back what was an endless decline.
With the Realm of Fire destroyed, the 677th dimension had already lost one of the world's most important orders. Reincarnation. Now, the souls of the dead had nowhere to go.
Behind the front lines, the Demon Army's Genesis Knights, gods, phoenixes, fleets, and mages continued to push back the Coalition members.
There were more who met their end, unable to get inside Lafrarosa's protective shield, than those who did.
Only an hour had passed since Kelliark appeared on the battlefield.

There were still seventeen hours until the seal was released. At this rate, Kelliark was certain to annihilate the entire Coalition within that time. No matter how many miracles occurred, no matter how fiercely they resisted, no matter how they threw their bodies for their beliefs and pride, it seemed like a fact that would never change.
"Father, what should I do?"
"Did you grow weak after aging for a moment? It's unlike you to ask such a question."
Chiron said, deflecting a beam from Kelliark that flew towards Luna's side.
"It's because I can't see an answer at all. I'm not afraid of fighting, losing, and dying. But when I think about the family, our comrades, everyone disappearing... I feel like I'm going crazy."
"Do you feel the demonization coming?"
"No, it's not that."
"It wouldn't. So it's fine even if you feel like you're going crazy. It means you are growing that much stronger. Besides, we are not the only enemies he has left, are we?"
Malugia.

Naturally, the Coalition was hoping for her to appear on the battlefield. Even if what she fundamentally wanted was destruction, there was a high possibility that it would create more variables favorable to the Coalition.
"I too would like it if Malugia came here, Chiron Runcandel."
Chiiiing-!
Spears of Light Origin were pouring down on Chiron's head. As his vision was still limited, deflecting such a volley of attacks was the most difficult.
Minor wounds increased in an instant. Aging immediately began from the affected areas, and Chiron moved his rapidly heavy and dulling body to escape the area where the spears were pouring down.
"It's best to take care of everything cleanly right here."

It wasn't a bluff. He wasn't the kind of person who needed to bluff. Kelliark still had a few more cards up his sleeve. Just as the Coalition had the cards of Solderet's legacy and Malugia's intervention.
And he was a person who didn't even need to hide those cards.
"The completed Origin Stone. Aren't you curious about what kind of power it holds?"
Kelliark, who had been floating in the sky until a moment ago, was now standing right in front of Chiron, extending his hand. Luna, Vahn, and Orgal simultaneously rushed in and struck his hand away.
The same pattern as the battle in the Empire was repeating. Three swords were embedded in his bare body, yet his arm distorted like a mosaic, nullifying all the attacks.
"This level of manipulation and distortion is possible even without an Origin Stone. This alone must be quite frustrating. But soon, the most outstanding Origin Stone will arrive here by my call."
This was the reason Kelliark was waiting for Malugia.
Once the completed Origin Stone arrived, it was as good as all variables being fundamentally blocked for him.
"I will absorb Malugia with that power. And I will obtain the power of the Sun God, and be reborn as a being who can perfectly control even time."
"You have a peculiar obsession with controlling time, Kelliark."

"How could I not, Chiron? It is the only power I have not yet obtained. I have killed or absorbed hundreds of Oltas until now. Yet, to control time, I ultimately need the full power of the Sun God. Malugia is that final piece."
A completed Origin Stone, the full power of the Sun God.
The authority of a Kelliark Zipple who possessed both was unimaginable. It was to a point where even Kelliark himself couldn't fathom it.
"To change the unchangeable, to make the non-existent exist, to be able to return down a path from which one cannot return... there could be nothing more enjoyable."

For the first time, Kelliark was showing signs of excitement. He burst into laughter like a madman and accepted the enemy swords passing through his body. Meaningless attacks that left not even a small scratch.
"Seventeen hours! That's the time you need to enter the subspace where Solderet's legacy lies. You will not go there. That is why I came here myself."
"Are you sure?"
This time it wasn't Chiron, but Jin. Kelliark turned his head and stared at Jin.
"Jin Runcandel, it seems your confidence has surged after enduring the aging?"
"You can probably read everything on this battlefield as if it were your own body. No, perhaps you can perceive everything that is happening not just on the battlefield, but in the entire Black Sea."
In fact, Kelliark was aware of even the small demonic beasts in the outskirts of the Black Sea hiding in their burrows. He could feel it naturally without even needing to strain his senses.

"For instance, you can perceive everything happening in this land right now. But didn't you just say with your own mouth that you have not yet conquered time? Then how can you be so sure of the future? Do you truly not know that the logic that the result is obvious simply because you are stronger than us can be overturned at any time?"
After a silence of about ten seconds, Kelliark nodded his head.
"Yes... you are right."
Paaaaat...!
Suddenly, the Genesis Knights attacking Kelliark were thrown back in all directions. They were pushed back by the Light Origin and Dark Origin magic that had exploded from him.

Then, the white and black magic began to stain the earth. Stepping on the land soaked in Light Origin would bring the aging of the body, and stepping on the land of Dark Origin would make the body disappear.
It was an overwhelming sight, but not an effective attack. The Genesis Knights could continue to fight at the same level without stepping on the ground.
However, Kelliark hadn't spread his magic to pressure the Genesis Knights.
"Until I devour Malugia, it's a story you can never refute."
Right after Kelliark finished speaking, something plummeted from the sky.
As if an entire star was falling, a huge, golden-glowing being crashed to the ground.
It was Malugia.
She had the same river-long hair as she did in the Empire, and that hair dug into the earth like roots, emitting sun energy.
But it was different from that day. Malugia's sun energy was not quickly pushing back Kelliark's magic that covered the ground.
It was because she was suffering more from the aftermath of the last battle than Kelliark was. That was also the reason she had fallen so violently, as if crashing.
"As I thought, you were hiding near the Realm of Fire... Malugia. Well, there was nowhere else to hide. You couldn't have done something as foolish as crawling into a dimensional passage."
From the moment he destroyed the Realm of Fire a little while ago, Kelliark had intended to deal a blow to Malugia, who would be somewhere around there.

That judgment was effective. Malugia had been focusing on her recovery and had stopped her existence, so she couldn't defend against Kelliark's grasp that had extended to the Realm of Fire and its surroundings. As a result, she had no choice but to appear on the battlefield now.

Originally, she was scheduled to intervene on the battlefield in a state of perfect recovery exactly fifteen minutes from now. According to Malugia's calculations, the Origin Stone would arrive on the battlefield an hour later than that.

Forty-five minutes. For Malugia, that was enough time to make it so that Kelliark couldn't use the Origin Stone even if it arrived. The judgment was that it would be possible if she could use the Vamel Alliance to pressure Kelliark together.
In other words, because she couldn't fill that fifteen minutes, a fatal problem had arisen in Malugia's plan.
"We have to protect Malugia!"
Jin shouted instinctively.
Right now, Malugia was clearly in a weaker state than she had been in the Empire. So the moment Malugia was subdued by Kelliark, the variable would disappear.
As soon as the Origin Stone arrived, Kelliark would absorb the subdued Malugia and gain the power of the Sun God.
While Jin was shouting, Kelliark was already using the magic he had spread on the earth beforehand like a net to try and bind Malugia.
The Genesis Knights reflexively took steps to avoid the magic, then, hearing Jin's voice, hastily changed direction.
"Keoheok...!"
"Kuhp!"
The magic of Light Origin and Dark Origin mangled the Genesis Knights' entire bodies.
Aging, being erased. There was a limit to Valeria and Enya's restoration. Once the limit was surpassed, it couldn't be reversed.
[The Light Origin, the aging, I will take it all! You all just block the Dark Origin!]
It was Orgal.
Due to his nature as a demon and having been chosen by Helluram, he was the one least affected by aging. He had already died once and been granted a new life by the Witch.
But no one could know.
How many years he could endure was a realm unknown even to Orgal himself. That also meant that the limit to which Valeria and Enya could restore him was also unknown.
If he were to block all the Light Origin magic now, an aging of over a thousand years could proceed at once. Perhaps even more than ten thousand years.
[Guaaaaaargh...!]
The Genesis Knights followed Orgal's words. They had no choice, as they could be annihilated while trying to save Malugia otherwise.
The Genesis Knights were seen pushing back Kelliark's magic and approaching Malugia.

When all the magic that had enveloped the earth disappeared, the Genesis Knights inwardly breathed a sigh of relief and checked on Malugia. Fortunately, she had gathered her energy and was looking for an opportunity to launch a counterattack on Kelliark.
And Orgal's fingers were withered and gaunt.
